title: Register needs_flutter/notifications/notifications_screen_l1 tags in dart_test.yaml to silence unknown-tag warnings
why: learning_tracker/dart_test.yaml's `tags:` block enumerates ~60 epic/story/misc tags but not `needs_flutter`, `notifications`, or `notifications_screen_l1`. Running any of these 3 files (verified for 2 of them) prints "Warning: A tag was used that wasn't specified in dart_test.yaml" on every invocation. It's non-fatal today, but a growing pile of unregistered-tag warnings trains developers/agents to ignore the warning stream, which is exactly where a genuine typo'd or newly-broken tag filter would also hide.
recommendation: Add `needs_flutter:`, `notifications:`, and `notifications_screen_l1:` to dart_test.yaml's tags: block (and any other in-use-but-unregistered tags found elsewhere in the suite).
acceptance_criteria: dart_test.yaml lists needs_flutter, notifications, and notifications_screen_l1.
`flutter test test/features/notifications/` runs with no "A tag was used that wasn't specified in dart_test.yaml" warning.
